name: Gabwise Skills
description: App Store & Play Store screenshots for a communication skills, public speaking, soft skills, coaching or microlearning app. Near black plum artboards with soft color glows and big Bricolage Grotesque headlines whose last line takes an accent color. An original cast was drawn for the set: three bright heads in profile and a speech bubble coach with a headset. A rating laurel sits under the first headline, a hand holds the phone among six skill bubbles, a speaker leans in toward a voice practice screen, two characters talk across a role play chat, three tilted review bubbles carry star ratings, and a streak badge and a level up card float over a progress screen. Bubbles, sparkles, laurels, stars and cards are native shapes you can recolor, and every part sits in a named layer group.
